scheme_name: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Internship
other_conditions: Applicant must be in the top 1% ranking in the 10th Board Examination
Applicant must be pursuing Science in Class 11th
Applicant must not have attended a similar INSPIRE camp earlier
Applicant must be a school student
Applicant must be within the same State or Union Territory as the camp
benefits_summary: A 5‑day residential science camp with lectures, hands‑on experiments and mentorship, plus an allowance of up to ₹6,500 per student.
documents_required: Endorsement Letter signed by the Head of the Institute
